obligation: ConstantTime implements TimeSensitive: control flow and demand addresses independent of secret values, conditional on public structure and valid inputs. Instruction latency is a separate CPU assumption.
public: pointers, allocation outcomes, slice lengths, layouts, type markers
points passed to audit_mul_normal and audit_mul_nonnormal; fixed generator
secret: scalar values including zero where permitted
point coordinates including identity for Zero types
preconditions: all typed values constructed by safe public API; inversion input nonzero
normal points normalized; dot product lengths public
empty point dot product currently panics (public-length functional bug); dynamic cases use nonempty inputs
